topics: The prophetic example and its authority

items.q: Which term is described by “a report first carried by a few people but later transmitted widely”?
o: Aziz
Mutawatir
Gharib
Mashhur
items.s: Mashhur is a report first carried by a few people but later transmitted widely.

items.q: The statement “a report whose chain is unbroken from the first narrator to the last” describes which of the following?
o: Mursal
Muallaq
Muttasil
Munqati
items.s: Muttasil is a report whose chain is unbroken from the first narrator to the last.

items.q: The statement “a report transmitted by two narrators at every stage of its chain” describes which of the following?

Ahad
Mashhur
Aziz
items.s: Aziz is a report transmitted by two narrators at every stage of its chain.

items.q: Which term is described by “the encounter in which the Muslims suffered a reverse after archers left their post”?
o: Hijrah
Constitution of Madinah
Farewell Pilgrimage
Uhud
items.s: Uhud is the encounter in which the Muslims suffered a reverse after archers left their post.

items.q: Sahih li-ghairihi may be defined as
o: the place of retreat where the first verses came down to the Prophet
the teacher's formal permission for a student to pass on what has been learned
a report in which a successor quotes the Prophet directly without naming a companion
a lesser report raised to the highest grade by corroborating chains from elsewhere
items.s: Sahih li-ghairihi: a lesser report raised to the highest grade by corroborating chains from elsewhere. The other options describe Cave of Hira, Mursal, Ijazah.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines Shadh.
o: a report contradicting a more reliable version handed down by a stronger transmitter
the oaths of allegiance given by men of Madinah before the migration
finding a written collection and transmitting from it without meeting its author
the wording or content of a report, reached after the chain has ended
items.s: Shadh: a report contradicting a more reliable version handed down by a stronger transmitter. The other options describe Matn, Pledge of Aqabah, Wijadah.

items.q: Which term is described by “a report contradicting a more reliable version handed down by a stronger transmitter”?
o: Shadh
Mudtarib
Mudraj
Maqlub
items.s: Shadh is a report contradicting a more reliable version handed down by a stronger transmitter.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Sunan Ibn Majah?

a report fabricated and falsely attributed to the Prophet, rejected outright
the collection strict in its criticism of narrators and sparing in legal commentary
travel undertaken in search of teachers and reliable chains of transmission
items.s: Sunan Ibn Majah: the collection holding many weak items beside sound ones, completing a well known set of six. The other options describe Sunan al-Nasai, Rihlah, Mawdu.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Year of the Elephant?

an individual transmitter who passes a report on to the next link
the season of an armed attack on the sanctuary at Makkah that ended in disaster

items.q: Which of the following best describes Marfu?

a report attributed directly to the Prophet himself
items.s: Marfu: a report attributed directly to the Prophet himself. The other options describe Constitution of Madinah, Athar, Shadh.

items.q: The correct meaning of Gharib is
o: a report first carried by a few people but later transmitted widely
a report transmitted by two narrators at every stage of its chain
a report in which a single transmitter stands alone at some point in the chain
a report whose chains fall short of the number needed to produce certainty
items.s: Gharib: a report in which a single transmitter stands alone at some point in the chain. The other options describe Aziz, Mashhur, Ahad.

items.q: The correct meaning of Sunan al-Nasai is
o: the collection holding many weak items beside sound ones, completing a well known set of six
the collection arranged by narrator and noted for grouping the variant chains of one report
the collection strict in its criticism of narrators and sparing in legal commentary
the topical compilation regarded as the most authentic work after the book of God
items.s: Sunan al-Nasai: the collection strict in its criticism of narrators and sparing in legal commentary. The other options describe Sunan Ibn Majah, Sahih Muslim, Sahih al-Bukhari.

items.q: The correct meaning of Sahih Muslim is
o: the collection holding many weak items beside sound ones, completing a well known set of six
the collection arranged by narrator and noted for grouping the variant chains of one report
the collection strict in its criticism of narrators and sparing in legal commentary
the large collection arranged by the name of the companion who reported each item
items.s: Sahih Muslim: the collection arranged by narrator and noted for grouping the variant chains of one report. The other options describe Musnad Ahmad, Sunan Ibn Majah, Sunan al-Nasai.

items.q: The correct meaning of Munqati is
o: a report whose chain is cut at the start, omitting the collector's own teacher
a report with a transmitter missing somewhere in the middle of its chain
a report whose chain is unbroken from the first narrator to the last
a report in which a narrator conceals a gap or a weak link in the chain
items.s: Munqati: a report with a transmitter missing somewhere in the middle of its chain. The other options describe Muallaq, Muttasil, Mudallas.

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains Wijadah.
o: learning a report by hearing it directly from the teacher's mouth
finding a written collection and transmitting from it without meeting its author
handing a written copy to a student with authority to transmit from it
reading a report back to the teacher so that its accuracy is confirmed
items.s: Wijadah: finding a written collection and transmitting from it without meeting its author. The other options describe Munawalah, Qiraah, Sama.
items.t: Ways of receiving and passing on

items.q: “guidance given by God to a prophet, of which the recorded example is the practical expression” is the definition of
o: Hujjah
Sunnah
Wahy
Hadith
items.s: Wahy is guidance given by God to a prophet, of which the recorded example is the practical expression.
items.t: The prophetic example and its authority

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Hasan?
o: an acceptable report whose transmitters fall slightly below the highest standard of precision
a report fabricated and falsely attributed to the Prophet, rejected outright
a lesser report raised to the highest grade by corroborating chains from elsewhere
a report with a continuous strong chain, free of hidden defect and of contradiction
items.s: Hasan: an acceptable report whose transmitters fall slightly below the highest standard of precision. The other options describe Sahih li-ghairihi, Mawdu, Sahih.

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains Mawdu.
o: a report fabricated and falsely attributed to the Prophet, rejected outright
an acceptable report whose transmitters fall slightly below the highest standard of precision
a lesser report raised to the highest grade by corroborating chains from elsewhere
a report transmitted by both al-Bukhari and Muslim in their collections
items.s: Mawdu: a report fabricated and falsely attributed to the Prophet, rejected outright. The other options describe Muttafaq alaih, Sahih li-ghairihi, Hasan.
